title: Run agent (prompt)
text: Trim the Angular form input and lock immediately.
explanation: An injectable singleton owns signals across all five routed Ionic pages. The synchronous lock applies before any await; the server repeats validation.

title: POST /api/agent/stream
text: POST JSON from the Ionic WebView or browser.
explanation: The public API URL comes from config.json. Browser fetch streams remain enabled; CapacitorHttp interception is disabled to avoid buffering SSE.

title: Validate; tools disabled
explanation: Strict Pydantic strings are trimmed, bounded to 1–4000 characters and reject extra fields. ASGI middleware also bounds actual bytes, media type and Origin.

title: streamAgent() / query()
text: Delegate a real FastAPI route to the Python service.
explanation: FastAPI returns native ServerSentEvent objects. A missing key exits before the query iterator is created. Invalid input fails before SSE headers.
code:
async def stream(body: PromptRequest):
    if not settings.api_key_configured:
        yield ServerSentEvent(event='error', data={'detail': MISSING_KEY})
        return
    try:
        async with asyncio.timeout(180):
            async with aclosing(agent.stream_agent(body.prompt)) as messages:
                async for message in messages:
                    yield ServerSentEvent(event='message', data=message)
            yield ServerSentEvent(event='done', data={'status': 'complete'})
    except Exception:
        yield ServerSentEvent(event='error', data={'detail': FAILURE})

title: Prompt; no built-in tools
text: Invoke the actual Python Claude Agent SDK.
explanation: The SDK owns the CLI runtime and Claude transport. This excerpt is the application boundary initiating that exchange, rather than a fabricated HTTP implementation.
code:
source = self.query_fn(prompt=prompt, options=self.agent_options())
    async with aclosing(source):
        async for message in source:
            if isinstance(message, ResultMessage):
                return self.result_data(message)
    raise RuntimeError('Agent ended without a final result')

title: Model response
explanation: The model exchange returns through SDK messages. ResultMessage supplies the final answer; contextlib.aclosing closes the iterator on success, failure and cancellation.

title: Safe SDK message
explanation: Text, subtype and normalized result fields are allowlisted. Thinking, environment, paths, tool inputs and session IDs do not enter public messages; exact key occurrences are redacted.

title: Update typed state
explanation: Timeline rows stop at 500 while final result processing remains independent. Expand a row to inspect syntax-colored JSON.

title: ResultMessage fields
explanation: The result contains text, turns, duration, estimated cost and is_error. A non-success subtype remains an error even when the SDK error flag is false.

title: SSE ResultMessage
text: Validate and dispatch a final ResultMessage.
explanation: Public contracts are runtime-checked before updating Angular. ResultMessage is a safe projection label shared by progress and final SSE events.

title: Render answer + metrics
text: Render safe Markdown and colored source code.
explanation: Highlight.js escapes code. Answer rendering additionally runs DOMPurify, suppresses model images and restricts links to HTTP(S); Angular sanitizes innerHTML again.

title: SSE done event
text: Require both final result and done.
explanation: The incremental SSE parser handles split UTF-8 and CRLF, comments, multiline data and multiple frames. A done event cannot override an SDK error result.

title: SSE error; no done
text: Emit a safe failure without a done event.
explanation: Simple-mode failures return HTTP 502. Detailed provider exceptions and submitted values are excluded from public errors.
code:

title: Error + snackbar
text: Show an error and accessible Ionic notice.
explanation: The same state drives inline errors and the app-wide toast. Finally clears timers and unlocks controls; cancel aborts the active fetch.

title: Key: SSE error / input: 422
text: Reject missing credentials before SDK work.
explanation: Simple mode returns HTTP 503; streaming emits error without done. Invalid JSON, media, body size, Origin and prompt constraints fail independently before inference.
